preconditions.description: The number of suspects n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of truthful suspects m must be between 0 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= n for a in answers)
preconditions.description: Each answer must refer to a valid suspect number between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly m 'Truth' statements and n - m 'Lie' statements.

postconditions.expression: any(stdout == 'Not defined' for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If there is ambiguity, the output must include 'Not defined' for at least one suspect.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == 'Truth' if answers[i] == f'+{i+1}' else True for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If a suspect claims to be the criminal, they must be marked as 'Truth' if they are the criminal.
